categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet label and modifications to src/wallet/spend.cpp and wallet functional tests
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where fundrawtransaction ignores the caller's max_tx_weight option when preset inputs already cover the target amount. In CreateTransactionInternal, bypassing coin selection skipped weight checks and defaulted to MAX_STANDARD_TX_WEIGHT rather than coin_selection_params.m_max_tx_weight, returning an unexpectedly oversized transaction.
